notes: The Foundation's $12 million figure is cumulative since 2010, not annual. The Foundation's 2023 expansion into forestation and conservation is environmental and not scored. Life Time Academy is described inside team-member training, so whether outsiders enroll is not entirely clear, and no enrollment figures are given; it is tagged external_education at level 2 only, and Community level 3 rests on E2. Life Time Foundation and LTA are the only external activities; the rest of Community evidence is employee development. Kids Academy, swim lessons and kids camps are fee-based member services with no figures and were not scored separately. 'Charity Events' appears only as a table entry with no description. The 51,800 member events reflect member social activity, not external education. Traps excluded: 'state-of-the-art' equipment; 'studio performers' (fitness instructors, not artists); Experience Life and digital 'content' (health and fitness content in general, not described as creative work); 'entrepreneurial spirit'; 'accessibility laws' (regulatory compliance only); member demographics (income, education, age) are a disclosure, not inclusion activity; 'diversified portfolio' of centers. Life Time Work co-working is not described as serving founders or small businesses. Item 7 excerpts repeat Item 1 content and add no new qualifying activities.
